test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech form of the following sentence.

They said, "They had a very good habit."

options.text: They told that we had a very good habit.
They told that they had had a very good habit.
They told that we have had a very good habit.
They told that we had had a very good habit.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They told that they had had a very good habit.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun:**
 
 
• Direct speech pronoun "they" is retained as "they" in indirect speech.
